What makes him unique

The Invention

Auto-Rotating Neural Networks

"When using deep neural networks, do we ever change the neuron itself?"

The Auto-Rotating Perceptron (ARP) introduces a novel activation mechanism that rotates in the weight space, tackling the vanishing gradient problem from a fundamentally different angle. Extended to the Auto-Rotating Neural Network (ARNN) family, this new architecture has been presented at the world's top AI venues and offers a fresh building block for deep learning.

  • Novel activation mechanism that rotates in weight space
  • Tackles vanishing gradient problem
  • Open-source Keras library (arpkeras)
  • Under review at TMLR (Transactions on Machine Learning Research)
